source='''def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    h = len(grid)
    w = len(grid[0])
    # Horizontal bars are the dense rows; vertical guide marks lie below them.
    bar_rows = [r for r, row in enumerate(grid) if sum(v != 0 for v in row) >= 3]
    if not bar_rows:
        return out
    last_bar = max(bar_rows)
    guide_cols = {c for r in range(last_bar + 1, h) for c, v in enumerate(grid[r]) if v != 0}
    for c in guide_cols:
        gaps = []
        for r in bar_rows:
            if 0 < c < w - 1 and grid[r][c] == 0 and grid[r][c - 1] != 0 and grid[r][c + 1] != 0:
                left, right = grid[r][c - 1], grid[r][c + 1]
                color = left if left == right else left
                gaps.append((r, color))
        for i, (r, color) in enumerate(gaps):
            start = 0 if i == 0 else gaps[i - 1][0] + 1
            for y in range(start, r + 1):
                out[y][c] = color
    return out
'''
p.write_text(source)
